messages:
Nora (Design): Heads-up: did a walkthrough of the trace header with support team. Main ask: make export + correlation ID faster to discover when you're mid-incident.
Priya (Product): +1. They said copying IDs is the most frequent action, export is less common but critical for audits.
Dev (Eng Runtime): Current header layout: [Share][Export][Copy ID]. I think we defaulted to export visually first because of space.
Alex (SRE): For paging through incidents we hit Copy ID 3-4x/session. If copy is buried it slows pager flow.
Evan (Accessibility): Also observed keyboard users can't reach export options quickly because it's a split-button that requires arrow key to open; not ideal.
Nora (Design): Proposal: promote Copy ID into a prominent pill (icon + label) and move Export into a dropdown menu with clear size estimates. Keep Share as icon-only.
Dev (Eng Runtime): Implementation caveat: moving DOM order might affect SR announce order. We can keep DOM as Copy -> Export -> Share and visually reorder if needed.
Evan (Accessibility): Please avoid pure CSS reorder without DOM changes; AT will read visually re-ordered content in DOM order which can confuse. Best is DOM order = logical order.
Priya (Product): Users expect Copy first in keyboard flow. So DOM order should be Copy, Share, Export.
Alex (SRE): One more: when an export is initiated show a small non-modal progress toaster with approximate size and percent. If full snapshot > 200MB require confirmation.
Nora (Design): Microcopy question: label for the big pill: "Copy trace ID" or "Copy correlation ID"? Support said "correlation" is ambiguous across teams.
Priya (Product): Use "Copy trace ID" — shorter and matches instrumentation docs.
Evan (Accessibility): Tooltips must appear on focus and expose aria-describedby. Also include "Copied" live region updates when copy succeeds.
Dev (Eng Runtime): I'll add aria-live=polite region for copy success and failures. Also will change split-button to a single button + menu to simplify keyboard flow.
Nora (Design): Visual note: increase hit area to 44px min for the pill, and ensure high-contrast border in dark mode.
Alex (SRE): Export options: CSV (light), JSON (includes metadata), Full snapshot (may contain PII). Add small text with estimated size next to each item.
Priya (Product): For Full snapshot show an inline warning: "Includes request bodies and headers" and require a checkbox in the confirmation modal. Log acceptance.
Evan (Accessibility): Confirmation modal must trap focus and use role=dialog with aria-modal=true. For the warning, use role=alertdialog or announce it when modal opens.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: trace-header-a11y-2025-02 by Dev at 2025-02-11T09:00:00Z
Dev (Eng Runtime): I'll wire the feature flag: trace_header_export_promo. Plan: default rollout 10% for 2 days, capture metrics: copy_click, export_initiated, export_confirmed, export_fail.
Nora (Design): I'll upload a compact and expanded comp to Figma and include the accessible interaction notes. Will add contrast spec and focus states.
Priya (Product): Add a tiny analytics event for how often users expand Export dropdown vs use quick-download. Want to know discoverability impact.
Alex (SRE): Also add server guardrails: max concurrent exports per-org + queue length visible in UI. If queue > 5 show "Processing... position #n".
Evan (Accessibility): Last bit: keyboard nav checklist: Tab lands on Copy, Enter copies. Tab -> Arrow opens Export menu. Arrow key cycling within menu. Esc closes and returns focus to Copy.
Nora (Design): Perfect. I'll iterate on spacing and send a follow-up with screenshots. Thanks team :raised_hands:
